name: qontext-film
description: The Qontext film: a narrated, captioned explainer rendered with Remotion from engine-drawn scenes and real clips.

scripts.cards: npm run fonts && remotion still Card ../src/site/public/og.png && remotion still Icon ../src/site/public/apple-touch-icon.png && ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i ../src/site/public/apple-touch-icon.png -vf crop=132:132:24:24,scale=32:32:flags=lanczos ../src/site/public/favicon.ico && node scripts/favicon.mjs
